# Serverless Constructs - general utility constructs

This repo contains some general utility constructs.

# Main Constructs

* [`CoreStack`](./classes/CoreStack.html) - the base CDK stack that should be extended by all Reference Architecture applications
* [`SelfDestruct`](./classes/SelfDestruct.html) - a construct you can use on your own, but usually is invoked through `CoreStack`

# Example

Here's an example of how you would use `CoreStack` in your own main application stack. This is basically what the MFE QuickStart application uses.

```typescript
export class MainStack extends CoreStack {
  public constructor(
    scope: Construct,
    id: string,
    appStackProps: MainStackProps
  ) {
    //...

    // These variables usually passed in as part of appStackProps
    const isFeatureBranch = !isProduction && envName !== namespace;

    super(scope, id, {
      ...appStackProps,
      isFeatureBranch,
      // By default feature branch stacks self-destruct in 7 days. You can override this.
      // selfDestruct: false,
    });

    // Rest of stack here
  }
}
```
